entries.title: Leviticus 15:1
segments: ¶And the Lord said to Moses and to Aaron,

entries.title: Leviticus 15:2
segments: Say to the children of Israel: If a man has an unclean flow from his flesh, it will make him unclean.

entries.title: Leviticus 15:3
segments: If the flow goes on or if the part is stopped up, to keep back the flow, he is still unclean.

entries.title: Leviticus 15:4
segments: Every bed on which he has been resting will be unclean, and everything on which he has been seated will be unclean.

entries.title: Leviticus 15:5
segments: And anyone touching his bed is to have his clothing washed and his body bathed in water and be unclean till evening.

entries.title: Leviticus 15:6
segments: And he who has been seated on anything on which the unclean man has been seated is to have his clothing washed and his body bathed in water and be unclean till evening.

entries.title: Leviticus 15:7
segments: And anyone touching the flesh of the unclean man is to have his clothing washed and his body bathed in water and be unclean till evening.

entries.title: Leviticus 15:8
segments: And if liquid from the mouth of the unclean man comes on to him who is clean, then he is to have his clothing washed and his body bathed in water and be unclean till evening.

entries.title: Leviticus 15:9
segments: And any leather seat on a horse on which the unclean man has been seated will be unclean.

entries.title: Leviticus 15:10
segments: And anyone touching anything which was under him will be unclean till the evening; anyone taking up any of these things is to have his clothing washed and his body bathed in water and be unclean till evening.

entries.title: Leviticus 15:11
segments: And anyone on whom the unclean man puts his hands, without washing them in water, is to have his clothing washed and his body bathed in water and be unclean till evening.

entries.title: Leviticus 15:12
segments: And any vessel of earth which has been touched by the unclean man will have to be broken and any vessel of wood washed.

entries.title: Leviticus 15:13
segments: And when a man who has a flow from his body is made clean from it, he is to take seven days to make himself clean, washing his clothing and bathing his body in flowing water, and then he will be clean.

entries.title: Leviticus 15:14
segments: And on the eighth day he is to take two doves or two young pigeons and come before the Lord to the door of the Tent of meeting and give them to the priest:

entries.title: Leviticus 15:15
segments: And they are to be offered by the priest, one for a sin-offering and one for a burned offering, and the priest will take away his sin before the Lord on account of his flow.

entries.title: Leviticus 15:16
segments: And if a man's seed goes out from him, then all his body will have to be bathed in water and he will be unclean till evening.

entries.title: Leviticus 15:17
segments: And any clothing or skin on which the seed comes is to be washed with water and be unclean till evening.

entries.title: Leviticus 15:18
segments: And if a man has sex relations with a woman and his seed goes out from him, the two of them will have to be bathed in water and will be unclean till evening.

entries.title: Leviticus 15:19
segments: ¶And if a woman has a flow of blood from her body, she will have to be kept separate for seven days, and anyone touching her will be unclean till evening.

entries.title: Leviticus 15:20
segments: And everything on which she has been resting, while she is kept separate, will be unclean, and everything on which she has been seated will be unclean.

entries.title: Leviticus 15:21
segments: And anyone touching her bed will have to have his clothing washed and his body bathed in water and be unclean till evening.

entries.title: Leviticus 15:22
segments: And anyone touching anything on which she has been seated will have to have his clothing washed and his body bathed in water and be unclean till evening.

entries.title: Leviticus 15:23
segments: Anyone touching anything on the bed or on the thing on which she has been seated, will be unclean till evening.

entries.title: Leviticus 15:24
segments: And if any man has sex relations with her so that her blood comes on him, he will be unclean for seven days and every bed on which he has been resting will be unclean.

entries.title: Leviticus 15:25
segments: And if a woman has a flow of blood for a long time, not at the time when she generally has it, or if the flow goes on longer than the normal time, she will be unclean while the flow of blood goes on, as she is at other normal times.

entries.title: Leviticus 15:26
segments: Every bed on which she has been resting will be unclean, as at the times when she normally has a flow of blood, and everything on which she has been seated will be unclean, in the same way.

entries.title: Leviticus 15:27
segments: And anyone touching these things will be unclean, and his clothing will have to be washed and his body bathed in water and he will be unclean till evening.

entries.title: Leviticus 15:28
segments: But when her flow of blood is stopped, after seven days she will be clean.

entries.title: Leviticus 15:29
segments: And on the eighth day let her get two doves or two young pigeons and take them to the priest to the door of the Tent of meeting,

entries.title: Leviticus 15:30
segments: To be offered by the priest, one for a sin-offering and one for a burned offering; and the priest will take away her sin before the Lord on account of her unclean condition.

entries.title: Leviticus 15:31
segments: In this way may the children of Israel be made free from all sorts of unclean conditions, so that death may not overtake them when they are unclean and when they make unclean my holy place which is among them.

entries.title: Leviticus 15:32
segments: This is the law for the man who has a flow from his body, or whose seed goes from him so that he is unclean;

entries.title: Leviticus 15:33
segments: And for her who has a flow of blood, and for any man or woman who has an unclean flow, and for him who has sex relations with a woman when she is unclean.
